questions.q: Which dessert would the author choose as the most perfect?
questions.e: In the video: "Da biram najsavršeniji kolač, to bi bile ledene kocke" — if I had to choose the most perfect cake, it would be the ice cubes.

questions.q: What is the topping for the cake base made of?
questions.e: In the video: "pravim preliv od vode, šećera i vanilin šećera" — I make a topping from water, sugar and vanilla sugar.

questions.q: How is the hot topping applied?
o: Into the pan before the dough
questions.e: In the video: "Vruć preliv ide preko vruće kore" — the hot topping goes over the hot cake layer.

questions.q: What is added to the thickened cream while it is hot?
questions.e: In the video: "dok je još vruće dodajem puter" — while it's still hot I add butter.

questions.q: What is the chocolate layer made of?
questions.e: In the video: "Čokoladni sloj pravim od Dr. Oetker crne čokolade, otopljene u slatkoj pavlaci." — I make the chocolate layer from Dr. Oetker dark chocolate melted in sweet cream.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Umutiti — to whisk, to mix until smooth.

questions.q: Dodam *brašno*, kakao prah i prašak za pecivo.

questions.e: Zgusnuti se — to thicken, from gust "thick".

questions.q: Za fil u mleko dodajem šećer, pa kad *provri*.
questions.e: Provreti — to come to a boil, to start boiling.
Preko ("over, on top of") requires the genitive case: preko kore.
Ostatak ("the rest") requires the genitive case: u ostatku mleka — "in the rest of the milk".

questions.q: Čokoladni sloj pravim od crne čokolade, otopljene u slatkoj ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" requires the locative case: u pavlaci.

questions.q: Dodam brašno, kakao prah i ___ za pecivo.
questions.e: The object of dodati is in the accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: prašak.
